nodes.label: ADR-0004: M1 walking-skeleton implementation choices
nodes.rationale: In-process MCP-shaped tool registry (no MCP transport yet — premature until a 3rd-party server is wanted); tool loop OpenAI-shape only; durability = message-state checkpoints on the task row; DDG Lite web search (fragile by design); no approval flow yet — non-auto tools are refused, not queued; no send tool exists at all.
